Title: UI Architecture Current State
Content: MemorySmith uses Blazor Server with Interactive Server render mode on all pages. The host is MemorySmith.App with MudBlazor 9.4 for components. Pages: /memories (MemoryViewer.razor) is the main workbench — a VS Code-inspired compact dark editor for browsing and editing MemoryRecords with inline source link editing and agent-context copy. /health (HealthStats.razor) shows stat cards (Total/Core/Working/Unconsolidated/Deprecated/AvgConfidence/TotalUsage/Readiness), two MudChart<double> activity charts (queries/day, changes/day powered by GetActivityBucketsAsync), a maintenance telemetry table, and a recent events list. /variables (Variables.razor) is a simple CRUD table for vars.json bindings used in source link %VarName% expansion. All pages use MVVM-lite: minimal code-behind, services injected. MudBlazor 9.4 breaking changes: MudChart is now generic (MudChart T='double', ChartSeries<double>), axis labels use ChartLabels not XAxisLabels. CSS is in wwwroot/app.css (append-only strategy due to duplicate blocks; do not use replace_string_in_file on this file).
